# VidCuts — In-Browser Video Cutter, Media Studio, 32 PDF Tools & QR Generator
> Engineered by Reeyansh Tech Solutions (https://www.reeyanshtech.in/)
> Live Website: https://scuts.reeyanshtech.in/ (or https://sivakumar8500.github.io/video-cutter/)

## Overview
VidCuts is a free, privacy-first, client-side web utility that processes video, audio, images, documents, and vector QR codes directly inside the browser using WebAssembly (FFmpeg WASM) and client hardware. No files are ever uploaded to cloud servers or third-party storage.

## Core Capabilities
1. **Split by Piece Count**: Divide any video evenly into N parts (e.g. 2, 4, 5, 10 clips) with exact timestamp boundaries.
2. **Split by Duration**: Slice video into fixed duration segments (e.g. 30 seconds for WhatsApp Status, 60 seconds for YouTube Shorts, 3 minutes for TikTok) with zero-loss remainder handling.
3. **Cut Particular Minute to Minute**: Set custom start (mm:ss) and end (mm:ss) timestamps, with "Set to Now" real-time video player synchronization and multi-clip batch extraction.
4. **16:9 to 9:16 Vertical Converter**: Transform landscape 16:9 videos into 9:16 vertical videos for Shorts, Reels, and TikTok using Blurred Background, Center Crop, or Letterbox styling.
5. **Top & Bottom Promotional Cards & Multi-Banners**:
   - Attach branded cards at the top and bottom with adjustable height (200px-800px), fit modes (Cover/Contain), zoom, padding, and background colors.
   - Attach multiple timed banners across the timeline (e.g., 0-6s banner 1, 6-12s banner 2, up to 10+ banners across 1 minute) with an interactive timeline scrubber.
6. **Media Tools**: Download video files from direct URLs, extract audio tracks to MP3/AAC, and mute/remove audio streams in one click.
7. **Image Studio**: Crop images to social aspect ratios (1:1 Square, 4:5 Portrait, 16:9 Landscape, 9:16 Story) or shape cutouts (Circle, Heart, Star, Hexagon) with transparent PNG export.
8. **32 PDF Tools**: Complete client-side PDF document manipulation: Merge, split, compress, watermark, rotate, page number, unlock, and AES-256 encrypt with zero cloud leakage.
9. **Vector QR Code Matrix**: Generate vector QR codes with 15 input protocols, custom logo embedding with 9-position alignment, color gradients, and camera QR scanner.
10. **Lossless Stream Copy**: Ultra-fast cutting in milliseconds without re-encoding when slicing MP4 files.
11. **Direct Folder Export**: Save all output clips directly to a designated folder on the user's hard drive using the File System Access API, or download as a single organized ZIP archive.

## Technical Specifications
- **Supported Containers**: MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WebM, M4V, FLV, TS
- **Supported Video Codecs**: H.264 (AVC), H.265 (HEVC), VP8, VP9, ProRes
- **Supported Audio Codecs**: AAC, MP3, Opus, PCM
- **Document Engines**: pdf-lib, @pdfsmaller/pdf-encrypt, @pdfsmaller/pdf-decrypt
- **Engine**: Single-threaded FFmpeg Core 0.12 running inside WebAssembly sandbox
- **Privacy Model**: 100% Client-Side. Zero server uploads. Works completely offline after initial load.
- **Price**: 100% Free Forever. No subscription, no account required, no watermark.
